_comment: Domains the weekly advice routine may cite. Edit this list to add or drop sources; validate.js rejects citations from anywhere else.

allowed.use: Primary. Season-specific mechanics, Exclusive Weapon and Awakening guides, timelines, tactics cards.
Per-hero builds (minimum/sweetspot/optimum gear), lineups, tier lists. Some skill orders are paywalled; never infer paywalled content.
Hero, gear and squad fundamentals; free skill orders for some heroes. Some pages are older; check dates.
Tier lists only, as corroboration. Never the sole basis for an upgrade action.

excluded.pattern: Top-up / recharge stores (topuplist, topuplive, buffbuff, and similar)
excluded.reason: Commercial content written to sell top-ups.

excluded.pattern: Content farms and hijacked domains (local news, council, retail sites hosting game guides)
excluded.reason: Low-quality or spam; frequently wrong hero names.
Blocks AI search tools; cannot be retrieved or cited.
